_comment: Accepted PS skill-audit findings. Regenerate with: npm run ps:audit-skills:accept
accepted: DESC|SM_SWORD|description|Increases damage with One- Handed Sword and Dagger class weapons. This damage ignores modifications from Armor and VIT defense, but not from Elemental and Card modifiers and applies to all hits of multi-hit attacks.

DESC|SM_TWOHAND|description|Increases damage with Sword class weapons. This damage ignores modifications from Armor and VIT defense, but not from Elemental and Card modifiers and applies to all hits of multi- hit attacks.

DESC|SM_MAGNUM|description|Drains a small amount of the caster's HP to inflict Fire elemental area effect damage on enemies in the caster's vicinity and force them backward. For ten seconds after Magnum Break, the caster's auto attacks and Magnum Break will receive a partial fire enchantment.

DESC|AL_DP|description|Increases VIT Defense against Demons and Undead monsters. ATK is lowered after other defense modifications are taken into effect. The effect is increased by base level slightly. [Formula]: VIT DEF = SkillLv * (3 + ( Base Level + 1 ) / 25)

DESC|AL_HEAL|description|Restores a target's HP or Attacks undead. Only Base Level and INT of the cast and the skill level affect the amount healed. On Undead monsters, the skill ignores MDEF and INT, but deals half Attack (after modifiers) for the undead property. Healing Effect on Players: [(Base Level + INT)/8] * [4 + (8 * Skill Level)] Attack Effect on Undead: [Heal Value * Element Modifier / 2]

DESC|AL_DECAGI|description|Decreases the target's movement speed by 25% and also dispels Increase AGI, Adrenaline Rush, Sword Quickening, Spear Quicken, and Cart Boost. Stacks with the effects of quagmire. Duration is halved on players. Success rate is equal to: [23 + (8 * Skill Level) + Base Level - Target Level]%

DESC|AL_CRUCIS|description|Reduces the Hard DEF of all Undead and Demon monsters on screen. Success rate equal to: [23+(8*Skill Level)+Base Level-Target Level]% Skill stacks with the effects of Provoke.
DESC|AL_ANGELUS|description|Temporarily Increases VIT defense of all party members on screen. Also adds a flat VIT DEF bonus (additive, applied before the multiplier) of 3 per Skill Level.

DESC|AL_BLESSING|description|Buffs the target and removes any curse effect on the target. When cast on Undead monsters or Demon Race monsters, this spell will reduce the monster's HIT and MATK but has no effect on ATK. Does not work on Boss Monsters or players of Undead Property.
DESC|MC_DISCOUNT|description|Allows buying items from NPC shops at reduced prices and selling them at increased prices. Also reduces the Zeny cost of Mammonite.
DESC|MC_OVERCHARGE|description|Increases damage inflicted with Axe and Mace class weapons.
DESC|MC_PUSHCART|description|Allows the character to equip and use a pushcart. Pushcart has an 8000 maximum weight capacity and 100 inventory slots. To access the cart directly use Alt+W
DESC|TF_MISS|description|Increases flee rate. Flee rate increases further upon reaching 2nd class. Assassins additionally gain a 1*SkillLvl % Movement speed bonus from this passive.

DESC|TF_STEAL|description|Steals an item from monster. Once an item is stolen from a monster, a second item cannot be stolen. Does not work on enemies that are Frozen, Stone Cursed, or Boss Monsters. The success chance of cast is equal to: [Drop Rate * ((DEX - TarDEX)/2 + 4 + 6 * SkLv)]%

DESC|TF_HIDING|description|Toggles the hide effect on the character on or off. Toggling the hide effect off consumes no SP. Hidden characters cannot move, attack or use any skills (except certain Rogue/Assassin skills) and do not regenerate HP or SP. The hide effect makes a character invisible to other players and monsters. This stops skills and spells that are targeted at you from working. Can be broken by Ruwach, Detect, Sight or Heaven's Drive. Insects, Demons and Boss monsters can see through hide.

DESC|ALL_RESURRECTION|description|Returns a dead character to life with the indicated percentage of HP restored. When used on Undead property (not to be confused with undead race) monsters, it has a chance to instantly kill or at least damage in the same way as Turn Undead at the same level.
DESC|KN_SPEARSTAB|description|Attacks an enemy with a forceful spear stab that will knock them back by 1+SkillLv cells and slowed for 3 seconds. Requires Spear class weapon.

DESC|PR_BENEDICTIO|description|This Benedictio Sanctissimi Sacramenti blessing endows the armor of all party members in a 3x3 area around the target with the Holy element. Requires only one helper to cast. Valid helpers include Acolyte, Priest, Crusader, and Paladin classes. Helpers do not need to be in any specific facing position. Undead and Demon monsters within the range of the skill will be damaged by Holy element equal to 1/2 the damage produced by a heal of the same level.

DESC|PR_SANCTUARY|description|Creates a 5x5 area sanctuary effect around the targeted cell. Characters and non- undead or Demon monsters within the sanctuary are healed once a second unless at max HP. If the monster entering the Sanctuary is Demon /Undead or Ghost race or Undead Element, it will take damage equal to half the Sanctuary's heal every second. Can heal up to 26 targets at maximum level or damage up to half that amount at maximum level. Capped to 3 instances at once.

DESC|PR_SLOWPOISON|description|Awakens the regenerative properties of the target, refreshing their HP at a very fast rate. Regeneration occurs every 3 seconds for 30 seconds. Cannot be cast on monsters (including the undead). The skill also negates the HP drain of Poison Status but does not actually cure Poison. This skill is dispellable like other buffs. Heal Amounts:

DESC|PR_LEXDIVINA|description|This skill has a chance of inflicting the Silence status on the selected target. Does not work against Boss monsters. The success rate is equal to: 100 - (TargetVIT + TargetLUK/8) + INT/15 %. Casting this spell on a target that is already silenced will remove the silence status.

DESC|PR_TURNUNDEAD|description|Attacks Undead monster with an exorcist skill that will cause a good amount of damage and has a chance to instantly kill the targeted Undead property (i.e., element) monster. This skill only works on Undead property monsters. Chance is halved if Base INT is below 40. Success Rate (no ceiling): [2*SklLv + 0.3*LUK + 0.1*INT + 0.1*BaseLv + up to 20% by target HP% + 1%*MeditatioLv]% On failure, the skill will do damage equal to: (BaseLv + INT + SklLv*10) * (3*(1 + LUK*3/200))

DESC|PR_MAGNUS|description|Calls down a Grand Cross in a 7x7 area around the targeted cell. Any Demon or Undead Race/Element monsters, or Ghost Element monsters entering the area of the effect suffer Holy property damage in waves. Waves occur approximately every 3 seconds and each wave hits a number of times equal to the skill level of the spell. The spell cannot stack with other ground effect skills (e.g. Pneuma and Safety Wall). Each wave hits Skill Level number of times with each hit doing damage equal to Magic Attack.

DESC|WZ_VERMILION|description|Hits the target area with a strong lightning attack that does 4 sets of hits with 10 hits for each set (total 40 hits). Can also silence any targets hit by this attack. the MATK damage is (20% MATK x Skill Lv x Wave #) 10% Chance to silence on each wave

DESC|WZ_WATERBALL|description|Hits the target with balls of water that exponentially scale with the level of this skill. The caster must be standing in water and higher levels of this skill require a larger water source. While natural water and the Sage skill Deluge cannot be depleted, Water Ball will empty tiles of a Ninja's' Watery Evasion skill when used. The level of this skill first checks the area around you based on skill level in a square grid then counts how many usable water tiles there are then fires waterballs based on the water available.

DESC|WZ_ICEWALL|description|Creates a row of 5 Ice Wall cells perpendicular to the line between the caster and the target cell and centered on the target cell. An Ice Wall cell cannot be entered. Ice Wall cells have HP that can be reduced by attacks and lowers at a rate of 50 per second. When the HP of Ice Wall reaches 0 then it will disappear. Ice Wall has a maximum duration of 5 seconds per skillLvl, or however long it takes for its HP to reach 0, whichever is lower. You can not have more than 5 Ice Walls active at the same time.
EFFECT|WZ_ICEWALL|Lv1|400 HP / Up to 5 Second Duration
EFFECT|WZ_ICEWALL|Lv2|600 HP / Up to 10 Second Duration
EFFECT|WZ_ICEWALL|Lv3|800 HP / Up to 15 Second Duration

DESC|WZ_ESTIMATION|description|Brings up a window with information about the targeted monster such as HP, element, level, etc at the time the spell is cast. Party members also see this window. [Passive Bonus] Provides +2% resistance to Fire, Water, Earth and Wind elemental damage.
DESC|BS_IRON|description|Enables the tempering of 1 Iron with 1 Iron Ore and 1 Mini Furnace. BASE Chance: [40 + 5 * Skill Level]% Final: [BASE + (JLVL/5) + (DEX/10) + (LUK/10)]%
DESC|BS_STEEL|description|Enables the tempering of 1 Steel with 5 Iron, 1 Coal and 1 Mini Furnace. BASE Chance: [30 + 5 * Skill Level]% Final: [BASE + (JLVL/5) + (DEX/10) + (LUK/10)]%

DESC|BS_ENCHANTEDSTONE|description|Enables the refining of enchanted ores with 10 Green Live, 10 Wind of Verdures, 10 Red Blood, 10 Crystal Blue, or 10 Star Dust with a Mini Furnace. BASE Chance: [10 + 5 * Skill Level]% Final: [BASE + (JLVL/5) + (DEX/10) + (LUK/10)]%

DESC|BS_REPAIRWEAPON|description|Repairs damaged weapons. Names of weapons that have been damaged are displayed in red text. Armors: Requires 1 Steel Level 1 Weapon: Requires 1 Iron Ore Level 2 Weapon: Requires 1 Iron Level 3 Weapon: Requires 1 Steel Level 4 Weapon: Requires 1 Rough Oridecon

DESC|BS_HAMMERFALL|description|Attempts to stun targets in 5x5 area surrounding the targeted cell. Stun duration is 5 seconds (reduced by VIT). Can be used with daggers, maces, swords and axes. Does not work against Bosses. Applies Mailbreaker(+10% Damage received) effect on target

DESC|BS_ADRENALINE|description|Decreases the user's attack delay with Maces and Axes by 30%, and with all other melee weapons by 20%. Decreases nearby party members' attack delay with Maces and Axes by 20%, and with all other melee weapons by 10%. This skill cannot stack, but overwrites weaker effects and effects with a shorter remaining duration.

DESC|HT_SKIDTRAP|description|A Skid Trap is a trap that activates up to three times when someone comes within proximity to it. When activated, the affected target is pushed back a certain number of cells. Skid Traps. are invisible, but any player who can see the Hunter laying the trap will be able to see the trap until they move out of sight of it. If Skid Trap triggers at least once, it cannot be recovered. Use of any Hide revealing skill will reveal the trap. This trap will affect Players in PVP zones, including the user. Does not work on Boss and Plant monsters. If not tripped by the end of the duration, the Skid Trap will turn back into a Trap item that can be picked up. Consumes 1 Trap.

DESC|HT_SANDMAN|description|Sandman is a trap that activates if stepped on. All targets in a 3x3 area around the trap will have a (60+10*SklLV)% chance of being affected by the Sleep status. Sandman traps are invisible, but any player who can see the Hunter laying the trap will be able to see the trap until they move out of sight of it. Use of any invisibility revealing skill will reveal the trap. This trap will affect Players in PVP zones, including the user. If not tripped by the end of the duration, this trap will turn back into a Trap item on the floor and can be reclaimed. Consumes 1 Trap.

DESC|HT_FLASHER|description|Flashers are traps that activate when stepped on. When activated it will have a (60+10*SkillLV)% chance to blind all targets within a 3x3 area around the trap. Those who are blinded by the trap also have a (4*SkillLV)% chance to perfect miss, meaning their attacks will miss regardless of their hit. Flasher traps are invisible, but any player who can see the Hunter laying the trap can also see the trap until they move out of sight of it. Use of any invisibility revealing skill will reveal the trap. This trap will affect Players in PVP zones, including the user. This trap is ineffective against Plant family and MVP monsters. If not tripped by the end of the duration, the Flasher will turn back into a Trap item on the floor and can be reclaimed. Consumes 1 Trap.

DESC|HT_BLASTMINE|description|A Blast mine is a visible trap that explodes a short period after it is set or when an enemy steps on it. It hits all targets in a 5x5 area around where the trap was triggered. This skill ignores DEF and MDEF and damage mod cards for size and family, but not elemental property. This trap will affect Players in PVP zones, including the user. The caster can move the trap before it is activated. Consumes 1 Trap.

DESC|HT_CLAYMORETRAP|description|Sets a Claymore Trap that is visible and explodes when stepped on, hitting a 7x7 area around the target cell with Fire damage. This skill ignores DEF and MDEF and damage modification cards for size and family, but not elemental property. This trap will affect Players in PVP zones, including the user. If not tripped by the end of the duration, the trap will turn back into a Trap item on the floor and can be reclaimed. Consumes 1 Trap.
DESC|HT_TALKIEBOX|description|Sets a trap which will last for 600 seconds and will display a prepared message for the person who triggers it. Talkie Box can trigger multiple times. Consumes 1 Trap.

DESC|HT_BLITZBEAT|description|Commands Falcon to attack a target. Leveling this skill also increases the chance of automatic attacks from the Falcon when attacking an enemy with a Bow Class Weapon. The Falcon's Attack Range is equal to the level of Vulture's Eye skill +3, up to 16 Cells. Autoblitz Rate is affected by LUK stat and has a 0.3% * LUK chance of automatically activating. Autoblitz can occur even if the arrow misses. Damage output from this attack is equal to: [LUK + (INT / 2) + Steel Crow * 6 + 20] * 2 Full damage will be dealt to each enemy hit.

DESC|AS_CLOAKING|description|Gives the player the Cloaked effect, it makes the user invisible to players and monsters but you don't lose the ability to move. Cloaked characters do not regenerate HP or SP, they can attack but this uncloaks them. Attacking while cloaked doubles the critical rate for that hit. Insects, Demons and Boss monsters can see through this invisibility. The Cloaked effect may be cancelled at any time by using the skill again (no SP Cost), by getting hit, reaching SP 0 or by coming into the area of effect of Attention Concentrate, Ruwach or Sight. Movement speed is increased if cloaking while against a wall. Level 3 or Higher: Can be used with Hiding. Deals double damage on first auto-attack from Cloaking state Move Speed with and without walls are as follows:

DESC|SM_FATALBLOW|description|Causes Stun status on targeted enemy when using Level 6 Bash or higher. The chance of inflicting Stun increases with Bash skill level and Base Level of the caster (Formula: BaseChance*BaseLevel/50). [Bash Lv 6]: 5% Stun chance [Bash Lv 7]: 10% Stun chance [Bash Lv 8]: 15% Stun chance [Bash Lv 9]: 20% Stun chance [Bash Lv 10]: 25% Stun chance

DESC|TF_THROWSTONE|description|Attacks an enemy with a Stone which inflicts 50 damage that cannot miss and will pierce enemy's defense and has a 3% chance to inflict Stun or blind status. Each cast requires one Stone.
DESC|MC_CARTREVOLUTION|description|Rams your Pushcart into a target, dealing splash damage and knocking it back. You must have a pushcart to use this skill.
DESC|MC_LOUD|description|Screams with battle vigor to grant +4 STR/VIT. Also increases the caster SoftDEF by 3/6/9/12 and nearby party members SoftDEF by 2/4/6/8 for 75/150/225/300 seconds.
DESC|AL_HOLYLIGHT|description|Summons holy light to counter evil. The skill does 250% MATK.

DESC|MG_ENERGYCOAT|description|While active, reduces damage from physical attacks by draining the caster's SP. See the table below for the skill's potency. [1-20% SP Remaining]: 6% DMG Reduction / Drains 1% SP Per Hit [20-40% SP Remaining]: 12% DMG Reduction / Drains 1.5% SP Per Hit [40-60% SP Remaining]: 18% DMG Reduction / Drains 2% SP Per Hit [60-80% SP Remaining]: 25% DMG Reduction / Drains 2.5% SP Per Hit [80-100% SP Remaining]: 30% DMG Reduction / Drains 3% SP Per Hit

DESC|RG_STRIPWEAPON|description|Forcibly strips the Weapon off a target. In PVP, targeted character temporarily cannot re-equip Weapon. On monsters, this skill will temporarily reduce the monster's Attack Power by 40%. Level difference between caster and target affects the chance of success If Full Strip is learned: Applies Stolen Strength Stolen Strength: Increases Attack by 20%

DESC|RG_STRIPSHIELD|description|Forcibly strips the Shield off a target. In PVP, targeted character temporarily cannot re-equip Shield. On monsters, this skill will temporarily reduce the monster's Defense by 30%. Level difference between caster and target affects the chance of success If Full Strip is learned: Applies Stolen Defence Stolen Defence: Increases Neutral resistance by 10%

DESC|RG_STRIPARMOR|description|Forcibly strips the Armor off a target. In PVP, targeted character temporarily cannot re-equip Armor. On monsters, this skill will temporarily reduce the monster's Magic Defense stat by 30%. Level difference between caster and target affects the chance of success If Full Strip is learned: Applies Stolen Spirit Stolen Spirit: Increases Wind, Fire, Earth and Water Resistance by 15%

DESC|RG_STRIPHELM|description|Forcibly strips the Helm off a target. In PVP, targeted character temporarily cannot re-equip Helmet. On monsters, this skill will temporarily reduce the monster's INT by 40%. Level difference between caster and target affects the chance of success If Full Strip is learned: Applies Stolen Mind Stolen Mind: Increases Magic Attack by 20%

DESC|RG_GANGSTER|description|After 5 seconds of sitting aggressive monsters, except Boss monsters, won't attack, health regenerate at a rate of 1% per second, and SP regens 10% faster. Party members sitting in the area also get these benefits, although the monster not attacking effect takes 5 second before it becomes active.

DESC|RG_COMPULSION|description|Purchases item from NPC shops at lower prices. [Level 1]: Discount Rate 9% [Level 2]: Discount Rate 13% [Level 3]: Discount Rate 17% [Level 4]: Discount Rate 21% [Level 5]: Discount Rate 25%
DESC|AM_AXEMASTERY|description|Increases attack speed and magic attack with Axe and Sword class weapons.

DESC|AM_LEARNINGPOTION|description|Increases effectiveness of healing items and potion creation success rate. Also grants a chance to preserve potions when using Potion Pitcher. Potion Pitcher Preservation: LUK * Skill Level / 60% chance to not consume potions.

DESC|AM_DEMONSTRATION|description|Targets a 3x3 area and sets it on fire, dealing damage every second. Flames cannot be placed adjacent to each other and require one cell of space between them. Reagent: 1 Bottle Grenade (optional) Reagent Effect: Has a chance to break the target's weapon.
EFFECT|AM_DEMONSTRATION|Lv1|240% Attack / 1% Chance to Break Weapon
EFFECT|AM_DEMONSTRATION|Lv2|280% Attack / 2% Chance to Break Weapon
EFFECT|AM_DEMONSTRATION|Lv3|320% Attack / 3% Chance to Break Weapon
EFFECT|AM_DEMONSTRATION|Lv4|360% Attack / 4% Chance to Break Weapon
EFFECT|AM_DEMONSTRATION|Lv5|400% Attack / 5% Chance to Break Weapon

DESC|AM_ACIDTERROR|description|Fling a bottle of corrosive acid at the enemy with a chance to cause Bleeding effect. Reagent: 1 Acid Bottle (optional) Reagent Effect: Has a chance to break the target's armor.

DESC|AM_POTIONPITCHER|description|Throws a potion at yourself or an ally, providing increased healing and unique bonus effects based on the potion used. Potion Effects: Red Potion: +15% MaxHP restored over time Orange Potion: Level 1 Endure Yellow Potion: +50% Freeze/Stun/Stone Resistance White Potion: +15% Healing Received Blue Potion: -30% SP Cost
EFFECT|AM_POTIONPITCHER|Lv1|+10% Healing Power, requires Red Potion
EFFECT|AM_POTIONPITCHER|Lv2|+20% Healing Power, requires Orange Potion
EFFECT|AM_POTIONPITCHER|Lv3|+30% Healing Power, requires Yellow Potion
EFFECT|AM_POTIONPITCHER|Lv4|+40% Healing Power, requires White Potion
EFFECT|AM_POTIONPITCHER|Lv5|+50% Healing Power, requires Blue Potion

DESC|AM_CANNIBALIZE|description|Puts a plant monster on a cell. The summoned plant gains bonuses based on the caster's stats. Plant Scaling: +3 ATK per STR -0.3% Attack Delay per baseAGI +20 Max HP per VIT +1 HIT per DEX +0.8% Geographer Healing per INT Reagent: 1 Plant Bottle (optional) Reagent Effect: Summons one additional plant beyond the default limit.

DESC|AM_SPHEREMINE|description|Summons a Marine Sphere. When damaged by allies or enemies, the sphere moves away and starts a 3 second countdown before exploding, dealing Fire property damage in a 9x9 area based on its remaining HP. Up to 3 spheres can be active at once. The sphere gains additional HP based on the caster's VIT. Sphere Scaling: +25 Max HP per VIT

DESC|CR_SHIELDBOOMERANG|description|Attacks an enemy from a distance by throwing your Shield. The Shield's weight and refine level affect the amount of damage that is inflicted. This damage dealt by this attack is always Neutral element. This attack cannot miss monsters, but may still miss players. Requires Shield.

DESC|CR_REFLECTSHIELD|description|Reflects a certain amount of damage back to the enemy after they inflict damage with a melee physical attack. Additionally, deals extra damage based on the caster's Soft DEF, Vit treshold, and Skill Level. This additional damage is affected by cards and armor element. Requires Shield.

DESC|CR_GRANDCROSS|description|Summons a cross of holy light on the ground around the caster that will damage enemies that come into contact with it. Grand Cross will cause the Blind effect on Undead and Demon monsters, but will not blind Boss monsters. The damage of Grand Cross is affected by both ATK, MATK, and Mastery damage, but +DMG% cards do not modify the damage of Grand Cross. While casting, Grand Cross grants immunity to knockback. The skill will damage the caster for 20% of their Max HP plus an amount based on the damage dealt to targets. The skill does three waves of damage, but will do fewer hits on mobs that are stacked on the same cell. The skill will always do at least one instance of damage.

DESC|CR_DEVOTION|description|Protects a party member by receiving all damage intended for that targeted ally. Devotion only works when level difference between caster and party member is within 15. Each active link consumes 5 SP every 5 seconds and is removed if there is not enough SP to maintain it. If the target moves 10 cells beyond the skill's range, the link becomes inactive until the target returns within range Damage received by the caster is based on the targeted ally's defense, not the Crusader's defense. This skill cannot be cast on other Crusaders. The Caster can have 1 additional target per skill level, up to five targets.

DESC|CR_PROVIDENCE|description|Strengthens the caster with a divine protection that increases MDEF and halves the Defense penalty caused by being surrounded by enemies. Providence cannot be interrupted or dispelled while active.
DESC|CR_SPEARQUICKEN|description|Increases attack speed when using spear weapons for the skill's duration. Also adds +1 FLEE/HIT per skill level.
DESC|MO_IRONHAND|description|Increases damage with bare hands Knuckle and Mace class weapons. Also increases FLEE.

DESC|MO_SPIRITSRECOVERY|description|After sitting for 5 seconds, the user gains the Spirits Recovery status which restores SkillLvl + MaxSP/200 SP every 5 seconds. The duration of this status is reset if a monster dies within 30 cells of the user and grants experience

DESC|MO_CALLSPIRITS|description|Summons Spirit Spheres, which are used by certain abilities. Call Spirits summons one sphere normally. Two spheres are summoned if used after triple attack (incurring no cast time) or after Finger Offensive is cast. Each spirit sphere adds 3 mastery ATK to attacks.

DESC|MO_ABSORBSPIRITS|description|Uses all Spirit Spheres and regains 10 SP per sphere. Can be used on another Monk's Spheres in PVP. If used against a monster it steals MonsterLvl*0.35+5 SP Ineffective against Boss monsters and WoE guardians.

DESC|MO_TRIPLEATTACK|description|Enables the chance of automatically delivering a triple attack in battle. This skill can be followed up with Chain Combo. or Call Spirits.. The chance of triggering, Triple Attack is increased by 0.2*SkillLevel per 10 Job Levels.

DESC|MO_BODYRELOCATION|description|Instantly teleport to a targeted spot if there are no obstacles between the caster and destination. Each cast requires 1 Spirit Sphere when not in Explosion Spirits status, except on GvG maps, where it will always require a sphere to use. On GvG maps, this skill cannot bypass Ankle Snare traps and the Monk will become snared.

DESC|MO_INVESTIGATE|description|Attacks an enemy with a massive psychic impact that will inflict more damage when the enemy has high Defense. Each cast requires 1 Spirit Sphere. Spirit Sphere is refunded if target is killed with Investigate Damage Output: ATK * (1 + 0.75 * Skl Lvl) * (Enemy DEF + VIT / 50)

DESC|MO_FINGEROFFENSIVE|description|Attacks a distant enemy by firing Spirit Spheres. Requires one Spirit Sphere per level. Refunds 1 Spirit Spheres when used, and an additional 2 Spirit Spheres if it kills a target. If only 1 Spirit Sphere is refunded, the next two Call Spirits used summon an additional Spirit Sphere.

DESC|MO_STEELBODY|description|Doubles the Monk's DEF and quadruples MDEF up to 90 as a maximum while decreasing Movement and Attack Speed. While this skill is active, other skills cannot be used. The Monk is immune to overcrowding reducing their DEF up to a limit of 23 enemies, at which point their DEF is reduced by 5% per enemy after 23. Each cast requires 5 Spirit Spheres.

DESC|MO_EXPLOSIONSPIRITS|description|Temporarily increases caster's Critical Attack rate for period of time. While this skill is active, Triple Attack is capable of dealing critical attacks. During the Explosion Spirits status, SP regen is suspended (Though Spirits Recovery functions). Combo skills are disabled while this skill is active. Requires five Spirit Spheres to cast.

DESC|MO_EXTREMITYFIST|description|Only usable during Critical Explosion status or briefly after Combo Finish or Chain Crush Combo. Inflicts a devastating amount of damage by consuming ()20*SkillLvl)% of the caster's SP. After using Asura Strike, the Explosion Spirits status is automatically canceled. Each cast requires 5 Spirit Spheres.
DESC|MO_CHAINCOMBO|description|Only usable during Triple Attack delay. Spins a target while attacking the enemy with a combo hit. This skill can be followed up with Combo Finish.

DESC|MO_COMBOFINISH|description|Only usable during Chain Combo delay. This skill can be followed up with the Asura Strike skill if the user has summoned at least 2 Spirit Spheres. Each cast requires one Spirit Sphere.

DESC|HP_ASSUMPTIO|description|Reduces damage taken from enemies by 20% for the spell's duration. Affects all party members on screen, similar to Gloria and Magnificat. Cannot be cast inside a guild castle, but retains its effect after entering one. Can be used in Battlegrounds and Sealed Shrine. Can now coexist with Kyrie Eleison.

DESC|HP_BASILICA|description|Blesses the caster's weapon with holy water, granting several effects: Attacks splash to up to 2 additional nearby targets. If the primary attack is a Critical hit, the splash hits are also Criticals. If the attack triggers Holy Strike, up to two additional viable targets can also be hit with Holy Strike. Area of effect: 5x5 cells.

DESC|HP_MEDITATIO|description|When meditating (sitting), you will have a better SP Recovery as well as increase your Maximum SP. This skill also improves the amount of HP that are healed by the Heal skill by 2% per SkillLV (sitting is of course not required). Also increases Turn Undead success chance by 1% per Skill Level.

DESC|ST_FULLSTRIP|description|Casts all four Strip skills at the same time. This skill's success rate increases if the caster has an higher level than the target. This skill works versus bosses, though the debuff is halved Learning this skill enables the Stolen Buffs. Only one Stolen Buff can be active at once. You may remove Stolen Buffs to get another by using any Strip Skill on yourself. Applies Stolen Core to Caster on success. Stolen Core: Applies all 4 other Stolen Buffs, but loses 1% health every 2 seconds for the duration.

DESC|HW_GRAVITATION|description|Increases the gravity in a 7*7 AoE which will decrease the Attack Speed of enemies and cause continuous damage that ignore Defense. This skill's effect on Attack and Movement Speeds does not apply to Boss monsters. If the player is 30 cells away from their gravity field, field will deal no damage. Has 1.5 second cast delay.

DESC|GS_GLITTERING|description|Consumes (2*SkillLv)^2 zeny to flip a coin. The caster will gain 2*SkillLevel coin. The caster can have a maximum of 10 coins. The zeny cost will automatically be adjusted to CoinsGained^2 (with minimum 4 zeny) in case caster already have coins There is (2*SkillLevel)% chance to not cost any zeny Gunslinger coins are displayed as glowing orbs around the caster. Each coin adds 3 mastery ATK while active.
DESC|GS_MAGICALBULLET|description|Fires 3 magic shot that does not use any bullets, inflicting an amount of Ghost elemental damage equal to the caster's (50 + DEX + Base_Lvl). Consumes 1 coin.

DESC|GS_SNAKEEYE|description|Increases attack range and HIT when equipped with Gun class weapons. The range bonus affects Rapid Shower, Tracking, Full Buster, Ground Drift and Spread Attack (only half bonus).

DESC|GS_FULLBUSTER|description|Inflicts devastating damage to an enemy by firing multiple bullets at once. When the skill has been mastered at 10 Skill Level, the player has 7% resistance against neutral damage. Requires Shotgun class weapon.

DESC|GS_SPREADATTACK|description|Consumes 5 bullets to spread damage over a large area. When the skill has been mastered at 10 Skill Level, the player has 7% resistance against neutral damage. Requires Shotgun class weapon.

DESC|NJ_KIRIKAGE|description|Strikes a target with an attack whose range is equal to the caster's Shadow Jump range. Shadow Slash no longer possesses the capability to land critical strikes. However, when paired with the platinum skill - Shadow's Within, critical hits become a possibility [In Hiding State]

DESC|NJ_BUNSINJYUTSU|description|Mirror Image can only be cast during Ninja Aura status, and consumes 1 Shadow Orb. Create a mirror image that will enable the caster to dodge a set number of long and short range physical attacks. Terminates any ongoing Cicada Skin Shed effects. While Mirror Images are active, increases the damage of Final Strike by (10+5*AttacksLeft)% on non-PvP/non-GvG maps Additionally, This skill can block single-target magic based attack.

DESC|NJ_KAENSIN|description|Summons a blazing storm in a 5*5 cell area around the caster that will deliver multiple strikes to enemies within its range. The Blaze Shield lasts for 20 seconds, but is automatically canceled after inflicting its maximum number of strikes. Blaze Shield has evolved into a skill that can now hit multiple enemies in a small area(AoE) or focus on one target. [Single Target] Deals 50% Fire property magic damage [AoE/Clustered Target] 3 Hits are consumed instead of 1.
DESC|KN_CHARGEATK|description|Charge at the single enemy that's away from you at range immediately. The further the enemy is from you, the higher your ATK will be.

DESC|DC_WINKCHARM|description|Charm a target by sending them a sexy wink. For those 10 seconds, the target monster will not attack you. The higher your level is when compared to the monster, the higher the chance of this skill working. If this skill is used on a player, it has low chance of causing the 'Confusion' status ailment. This skill only works on DemiHuman, Angel and Demon type monsters and obviously, does not work against Boss monsters.
DESC|MO_KITRANSLATION|description|Transfer one of your Spirit Spheres to another person. Uses up 1 Spirit Sphere.

DESC|MO_BALKYOUNG|description|Focus your inner energies and attack an enemy to deal damage and push them away. The targeted enemy receives 300% damage, and nearby monsters will be pushed away 2 cells and stunned for 2 sec. Drains a small amount of HP per use.
